method: Run the locked pure-core tests with nightly cargo-llvm-cov --branch, separately for default and BLE.
Use LLVM native per-source branch summary counters, subtracting only branch outcomes in syn-derived test-only syntax spans.
No production source, function, or branch is excluded. Tests outside core/src are not production.
Also retain exact LCOV BRDA records and a source-line/block/branch counter union using maximum taken count for duplicate IDs.
Native summaries and BRDA counter unions may differ in covered outcomes across variants; use the lower native filtered summary as headline rather than claim the higher export-derived percentage.
limitations: Rust/LLVM branch instrumentation is unstable; cargo-llvm-cov emitted that warning.
The native summary/BRDA inconsistency is observable in the saved exports for duplicate source locations across unit and integration instantiations; no upstream cause or correction is claimed.
This reports instrumented branch outcomes, not MC/DC, complete enum-transition coverage, hardware behavior, or a release branch gate.
No branch minimum is specified by the plan. Existing line gates are separate and were not replaced by this diagnostic.
The branch run uses cargo test --tests; it does not instrument doctests.
